title: fix(app-shell): the Console top bar stays silent on a successful connect
body:
Fixes #12891
Clause-②: no

The Console top bar no longer flashes a green "Connected" chip for 2 s after load. A successful connect (`connected`) renders nothing from the first frame; the `showConnected` state and its 2000 ms timer are removed. `connecting`, `reconnecting`, `disconnected` and `error` are unchanged. No tooltip, setting, constant or prop was added (triage route 6235395258: silent on a successful connect).

## Readers of the `connected` text and the timer (A1)

Before (at c999d4c017): `ConnectionStatus.tsx` read `topbar.connection.connected` through its `statusConfig` row and drew it while `showConnected` was true (the 2000 ms `setTimeout`); the only other reader was the objectui#12295 test constant `CONNECTED`, which pinned the flash. The ten language packs carried the key.

After: no source reader of `topbar.connection.connected` remains (`git grep` over packages, apps, scripts outside the packs: the objectui#12295 test constant only, now asserting absence). `showConnected` and `setTimeout` are gone from the component. The key is retired from all ten packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh); `statusConfig` is typed over `Exclude<ConnectionState, 'connected'>`.

## Pins and ablation (A2)

- New `ConnectionStatus.silentWhenConnected-12891.test.tsx`: (a) on the transition to `connected` the component renders nothing at 0, 1, 1000, 1999, 2000 and 60000 ms, and when mounted connected; (b) CONTROL: `connecting`, `reconnecting`, `disconnected` and `error` still draw their chip.
- `ConnectionStatus.followsRequests-12295.test.tsx`: the two assertions that pinned the 2 s flash now assert absence, with the reason beside the edit (objectui#12891 routed it silent). The outage-state pins (reconnecting stays up, error stays up, a 500 leaves it hidden) are unchanged.
- Ablation (flash put back in `ConnectionStatus.tsx`, one run, under the shared lock, restore trap armed): 6 of 10 tests red (both new (a) pins and the four 12295 tests that reach the connected state), the 4 control pins stayed green. Direction: red, as expected. Mutation was proven on disk before the run (marker count 1 of 1). Restore proven by blob hash: worktree and HEAD blob both 49fae23151451534d13ada3fc81f6101867e311a, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the component by relative path, so no rebuild is involved.

## Gates

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` on the two ConnectionStatus tests plus `ellipsis-glyph-3878.test.ts`: 3 files, 17 tests passed. `packages/i18n/` whole dir: 83 files passed, 1325 tests passed, 13 skipped.
- Type-check: closure `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` then `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (src and tsconfig.test.json): exit 0.
- eslint with `--no-inline-config` over the 16 changed files: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (a report): exit 0. `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`: all exit 0. `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, recorded, not touched.

## Declared narrowing (NOT MEASURED)

`vitest` over the whole `packages/app-shell/` dir and over `packages/app-shell/src/layout/` each hit the 8-9 minute foreground cap under the shared lock (exit 124, no verdict). Not measured: the rest of the app-shell suite. The reachable consumers were run instead: the two ConnectionStatus tests; every `AppHeader` test that touches the chip mocks `ConnectionStatus` itself, so the change cannot move them. CI runs the full suite.

## Acceptance notes

The 12295 PR described the 2000 ms auto-hide as correct; this card is the maintainer's walk asking to remove the flash, and triage routed it silent, so the 12295 flash pins were edited rather than kept.
